# Seat arithmetic from the LAST FEDERAL ELECTION RESULT (MD's party_pop_elect_array, written by
# hold_elections), not from today's polls: between elections the Bundestag only changes through
# coalition changes and defectors - as in a roleplay game where the vote has been counted.
# Parties above the 5% hurdle share the seats; defectors are subtracted from the government side.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_update_bundestag = {
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_cache_election_shares = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^0 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^0 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^1 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^1 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^2 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^2 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^3 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^3 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^4 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^4 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^5 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^5 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^6 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^6 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^7 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^7 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^8 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^8 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^9 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^9 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^10 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^10 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^11 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^11 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^12 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^12 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^13 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^13 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^14 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^14 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^15 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^15 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^16 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^16 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^17 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^17 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^18 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^18 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^19 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^19 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^20 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^20 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^21 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^21 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^22 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^22 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^23 > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = cwger_parliament_shares^23 } }
	set_temp_variable = { cwger_t_gov = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = ruling_party check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^ruling_party > 0.0499 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_gov = cwger_parliament_shares^ruling_party }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = gov_coalition_array
		value = v
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^v > 0.0499 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t_gov = cwger_parliament_shares^v } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_t_sum < 0.01 } } set_temp_variable = { cwger_t_sum = 1 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_seats_gov = cwger_t_gov } }
	hidden_effect = { divide_variable = { cwger_seats_gov = cwger_t_sum } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwger_seats_gov = cwger_seats_total } }
	round_variable = cwger_seats_gov
	hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { cwger_seats_gov = cwger_defectors } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_seats_opp = cwger_seats_total } }
	hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { cwger_seats_opp = cwger_seats_gov } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_margin = cwger_seats_gov } }
	hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { cwger_margin = cwger_majority } }
}


# Feeds the 'State of the Republic' and GDR dynamic modifiers from the system meters.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_update_modifiers = {
	# security state: order but at the price of liberal credibility
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_dm_police = cwger_security } }
	hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { cwger_dm_police = 40 } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwger_dm_police = 0.004 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_dm_stab = cwger_rechtsstaat } }
	hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { cwger_dm_stab = 60 } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwger_dm_stab = 0.001 } }
	set_temp_variable = { cwger_t = cwger_terror_left }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t = cwger_terror_right }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t = cwger_terror_foreign }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwger_t = -0.0006 }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_dm_stab = cwger_t } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_dm_pp = cwger_scandal } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwger_dm_pp = -0.002 } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_dm_pp = 0.02 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_dm_interest = cwger_bundesbank } }
	hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { cwger_dm_interest = 30 } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwger_dm_interest = 0.004 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_dm_ideo = cwger_westbindung } }
	hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { cwger_dm_ideo = 50 } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwger_dm_ideo = 0.002 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_dm_trade = cwger_ostpolitik } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwger_dm_trade = 0.002 } }
	# a hostile Bundesrat costs political capital until a package deal is struck
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_bundesrat_deal }
			OR = {
				AND = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } check_variable = { cwger_bundesrat_union > 50 } }
				AND = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } check_variable = { cwger_bundesrat_union < 50 } }
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { cwger_dm_pp = 0.08 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_bundesrat_hostile
	}
	else = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_bundesrat_hostile }
	# the peace movement lowers war support, the burden of the East lowers tax income
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_dm_ws = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_peace_movement > 30 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_dm_ws = cwger_peace_movement } }
		hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { cwger_dm_ws = 30 } }
		hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwger_dm_ws = -0.003 } }
	}
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_dm_tax = cwger_east_burden } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwger_dm_tax = -0.0015 } }
	# Stasi penetration slows research: plans and prototypes end up in East Berlin
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_dm_research = cwger_stasi_penetration } }
	hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { cwger_dm_research = cwger_counterintel } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_dm_research < 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_dm_research = 0 } } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwger_dm_research = -0.001 } }
	# MD counter-terror system: BKA capability and GSG 9 feed the national detection and defence values
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_dm_ct_detect = cwger_bka_level } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwger_dm_ct_detect = 0.05 } }
	set_temp_variable = { cwger_t = cwger_counterintel }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwger_t = 0.001 }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_dm_ct_detect = cwger_t } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_dm_ct_defence = cwger_gsg9_tier } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwger_dm_ct_defence = 0.05 } }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = DDR }
		DDR = {
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwddr_dm_stab = cwddr_crisis } }
			hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { cwddr_dm_stab = 30 } }
			hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwddr_dm_stab = -0.003 } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwddr_dm_consumer = cwddr_hard_currency } }
			hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwddr_dm_consumer = 0.0015 } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwddr_dm_pp = cwddr_sed_control } }
			hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { cwddr_dm_pp = 60 } }
			hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwddr_dm_pp = 0.002 } }
			# people who leave are missing in the factories
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwddr_dm_workforce = cwddr_exit_pressure } }
			hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwddr_dm_workforce = -0.0008 } }
			force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		}
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- terrorism
COLDWAR_GER_1970_terror_tick = {
	# RAF sympathiser milieu: repression and a weak rule of law feed it, integration drains it
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_security > 60 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_milieu = 0.5 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_rechtsstaat < 50 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_milieu = 0.4 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_kinkel_initiative } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_milieu = -0.8 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_hunger_strike } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_milieu = 0.6 } } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_milieu = -0.15 } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_raf_milieu min = 0 max = 100 } }
	# recruitment and attrition of the underground
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_raf_gen < 4 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwger_t = cwger_raf_milieu }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwger_t = 0.018 }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_cadre = cwger_t } }
	}
	# national counter-terror detection from the MD counter-terror system helps every manhunt
	set_temp_variable = { cwger_t_ct = modifier@terror_threat_detection_modifier }
	random_list = {
		94 = { }
		6 = {
			modifier = { add = 3 check_variable = { cwger_t_ct > 0.1 } }
			modifier = { add = 3 check_variable = { cwger_t_ct > 0.25 } }
			modifier = { add = 4 check_variable = { cwger_bka_level > 0 } }
			modifier = { add = 4 check_variable = { cwger_bka_level > 1 } }
			modifier = { add = 3 check_variable = { cwger_bka_level > 2 } }
			modifier = { add = 3 check_variable = { cwger_security > 60 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0.6 check_variable = { cwger_raf_gen = 3 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { cwger_raf_cadre < 3 } }
			COLDWAR_GER_1970_raf_arrests = yes
		}
	}
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_raf_cadre min = 0 max = 120 } }
	# threat values
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_terror_left = cwger_raf_cadre } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwger_terror_left = 0.9 } }
	set_temp_variable = { cwger_t = cwger_raf_milieu }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwger_t = 0.35 }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_terror_left = cwger_t } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_j2m_dissolved } date < 1980.6.2 } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_terror_left = 5 } } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_rz_dissolved } date > 1973.1.1 date < 1995.1.1 } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_terror_left = 4 } } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_terror_left min = 0 max = 100 } }
	# right-wing threat: far-right vote, refugee arrivals, unemployment-driven anger
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_terror_right = party_pop_array^21 } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwger_terror_right = 220 } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_terror_right = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_wsg_hoffmann_active } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_terror_right = 8 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_asylum_surge } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_terror_right = 14 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_far_right_banned } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_terror_right = -6 } } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_terror_right min = 0 max = 100 } }
	# foreign and state-linked threat follows world tension and the Middle East
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_terror_foreign = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		set_temp_variable = { cwger_t = global.mdcw_cw_tension }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwger_t = 0.15 }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_terror_foreign = cwger_t } }
	}
	if = { limit = { date > 1983.1.1 date < 1990.1.1 } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_terror_foreign = 6 } } }
	if = { limit = { date > 1992.1.1 date < 2000.1.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_pkk_banned } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_terror_foreign = 8 } } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_terror_foreign min = 0 max = 100 } }
	# attack rolls (one vector per month at most)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_attack_cooldown } }
		random_list = {
			100 = { }
			# RAF attacks come from the planning model in the internal security window (COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_tick)
			1 = {
				modifier = { add = 3 check_variable = { cwger_terror_right > 25 } }
				modifier = { add = 4 check_variable = { cwger_terror_right > 45 } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_attack_cooldown days = 60 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.62 days = 1 }
			}
			1 = {
				modifier = { add = 2 check_variable = { cwger_terror_foreign > 20 } }
				modifier = { add = 3 check_variable = { cwger_terror_foreign > 35 } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_attack_cooldown days = 60 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.65 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	# generation changes of the RAF
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwger_raf_gen = 1 } check_variable = { cwger_raf_prisoners > 3 } date > 1972.6.1 }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_raf_gen = 2 } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.50 days = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwger_raf_gen = 2 } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_deutscher_herbst_over }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_raf_gen = 3 } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.58 days = 120 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwger_raf_gen = 3 } check_variable = { cwger_raf_milieu < 10 } check_variable = { cwger_raf_cadre < 6 } date > 1990.1.1 }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_raf_gen = 4 } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.60 days = 5 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_raf_arrests = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwger_t = cwger_raf_cadre }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwger_t = 0.2 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwger_t = 1 }
	hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { cwger_raf_cadre = cwger_t } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_prisoners = 1 } }
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_arrest_best = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_bka_level > 2 } } random_list = { 50 = { } 50 = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_prisoners = 1 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_arrest_best = yes } } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_arrest_news_cooldown } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_arrest_news_cooldown days = 300 value = 1 }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.49 days = 1 }
	}
}

# Chooses the kind of RAF action from the generation, the number of prisoners and
# whether the state has already shown itself open to blackmail.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_raf_attack = {
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_attack_cooldown days = 75 value = 1 }
	random_list = {
		40 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0.5 check_variable = { cwger_raf_gen > 1 } }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.51 days = 1 }
		}
		25 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { cwger_raf_gen = 1 } }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 check_variable = { cwger_raf_gen = 3 } }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.52 days = 1 }
		}
		30 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { cwger_raf_prisoners < 3 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_hostage_crisis_active }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_state_blackmailable }
			modifier = { factor = 0.3 check_variable = { cwger_raf_gen = 3 } }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_hostage_crisis_active
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.53 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# GSG 9 rescue roll. Sets COLDWAR_GER_1970_rescue_success or COLDWAR_GER_1970_rescue_failure for the calling event.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rescue_roll = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_rescue_success
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_rescue_failure
	random_list = {
		35 = {
			modifier = { add = 20 check_variable = { cwger_gsg9_tier > 0 } }
			modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwger_gsg9_tier > 1 } }
			modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwger_gsg9_tier > 2 } }
			modifier = { add = 5 check_variable = { cwger_bka_level > 1 } }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_rescue_success
		}
		45 = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_rescue_failure
		}
	}
}


# --------------------------------------------------------- inner-German dynamics
# Monthly, called in GER scope. Moves the GDR meters and checks the stages of a GDR crisis.
# Nothing here is dated: the crisis comes when the numbers say so, or never.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_inner_german_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = DDR DDR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_ddr_initialized } NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_achieved } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwger_t_ost = cwger_ostpolitik }
		DDR = {
			# hard currency: the plan economy runs deeper into Western debt every year
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_hard_currency = 0.17 } }
			if = { limit = { date > 1979.6.1 } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_hard_currency = 0.08 } } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_swing_high } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_hard_currency = -0.06 } } }
			# Western television and radio
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_west_media = 0.03 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_t_ost > 60 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_west_media = 0.04 } } }
			# exit pressure
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_exit_pressure = 0.03 } }
			set_temp_variable = { t = cwddr_west_media }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { t = 50 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { t = 0.002 }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_exit_pressure = t } }
			set_temp_variable = { t = cwddr_hard_currency }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { t = 50 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { t = 0.002 }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_exit_pressure = t } }
			set_temp_variable = { t = cwger_t_ost }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { t = 50 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { t = 0.0015 }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_exit_pressure = t } }
			# civic opposition grows when people want out and the Party cannot answer
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_opposition = 0.02 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwddr_exit_pressure > 50 } }
				set_temp_variable = { t = cwddr_exit_pressure }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { t = 50 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { t = 0.004 }
				hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_opposition = t } }
			}
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwddr_sed_control > 80 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_opposition = -0.05 } } }
			# Moscow's guarantee follows the Soviet course
			if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SOV_gor_the_sinatra_doctrine } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing = -1.5 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { OR = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SOV_gor_new_thinking has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SOV_gor_glasnost_first } } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing = -0.6 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SOV_the_brezhnev_doctrine } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing = 0.2 } } }
			if = { limit = { date > 1986.6.1 } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing = -0.25 } } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = SOV } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing = -5 } } }
			# SED control relaxes towards a level set by Moscow and the opposition
			set_temp_variable = { t = cwddr_moscow_backing }
			multiply_temp_variable = { t = 0.4 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { t = 55 }
			set_temp_variable = { t2 = cwddr_opposition }
			multiply_temp_variable = { t2 = 0.4 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { t = t2 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { t = cwddr_sed_control }
			multiply_temp_variable = { t = 0.05 }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_sed_control = t } }
			hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_hard_currency min = 0 max = 100 } }
			hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_west_media min = 0 max = 95 } }
			hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_exit_pressure min = 0 max = 100 } }
			hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_opposition min = 0 max = 100 } }
			hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_moscow_backing min = 0 max = 100 } }
			hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_sed_control min = 0 max = 100 } }
			# crisis index
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwddr_crisis = cwddr_exit_pressure } }
			hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwddr_crisis = 0.3 } }
			set_temp_variable = { t = cwddr_opposition }
			multiply_temp_variable = { t = 0.25 }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_crisis = t } }
			set_temp_variable = { t = cwddr_hard_currency }
			multiply_temp_variable = { t = 0.2 }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_crisis = t } }
			set_temp_variable = { t = cwddr_west_media }
			multiply_temp_variable = { t = 0.1 }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_crisis = t } }
			set_temp_variable = { t = 100 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { t = cwddr_sed_control }
			multiply_temp_variable = { t = 0.15 }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_crisis = t } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing < 50 } }
				set_temp_variable = { t = 50 }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { t = cwddr_moscow_backing }
				multiply_temp_variable = { t = 0.6 }
				hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_crisis = t } }
			}
			hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_crisis min = 0 max = 100 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_check_wende = yes
	}
}

# Stages of a GDR crisis. 0 calm, 1 exit wave, 2 street protests, 3 open border,
# 4 transition, 5 unity negotiations, 9 crushed (Chinese solution), 10 settled.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_check_wende = {
	if = {
		limit = { DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage = 0 } check_variable = { cwddr_crisis > 49 } } date > 1974.1.1 }
		DDR = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage = 1 } } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.130 days = 2 }
		DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER_DDR.30 days = 2 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage = 1 } check_variable = { cwddr_crisis > 59 } } }
		DDR = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage = 2 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER_DDR.31 days = 3 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage = 9 } check_variable = { cwddr_crisis > 74 } } }
		DDR = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage = 2 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER_DDR.38 days = 3 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage = 1 } check_variable = { cwddr_crisis < 35 } } }
		DDR = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage = 0 } } }
	}
}

# Stage 3: the border opens.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_wall_opens = {
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_wall_open
	DDR = {
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage = 3 } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_sed_control = -25 } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_exit_pressure = 15 } }
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_sed_control min = 0 max = 100 } }
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_exit_pressure min = 0 max = 100 } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER_DDR.33 days = 1 }
	}
	GER = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.133 days = 1 } }
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- unity
# Transfers the GDR's states and armed forces to the Federal Republic.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_absorb_ddr = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = DDR }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_achieved
		annex_country = { target = DDR transfer_troops = yes }
		every_state = {
			limit = { is_core_of = DDR }
			add_core_of = GER
		}
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_seats_total = 662 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_majority = 332 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_east_burden = 70 } }
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_aufbau_ost
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_hallstein_legacy } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_hallstein_legacy }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_frontline_state } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_frontline_state }
		# the eastern electorate brings the PDS and the eastern civic movement
		set_temp_variable = { party_index = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { party_popularity_increase = 0.024 }
		set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = 0.024 }
		change_relative_party_popularity = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_update_bundestag = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_art23 = {
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_absorb_ddr = yes
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_art23
	add_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_two_plus_four
	add_stability = 0.05
	add_political_power = 150
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_art146 = {
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_absorb_ddr = yes
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_art146
	add_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_new_constitution
	add_stability = 0.08
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_neutral = {
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_absorb_ddr = yes
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_neutral
	add_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_neutral_germany
	if = { limit = { has_idea = NATO_member } NATO_leave = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
	set_temp_variable = { modify_europeanism = -10 }
	set_temp_variable = { modify_europeanism_target = ROOT.id }
	europeanism_change = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_new_alignment = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_free = 1 }
		mdcw_cw_change_alignment = yes
	}
}

# Confederation: the GDR remains a state but becomes bound to the Federal Republic.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_confederation = {
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_confederation
	every_other_country = { limit = { DDR = { is_subject_of = PREV } } end_puppet = DDR }
	DDR = { if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes } }
	set_autonomy = { target = DDR autonomy_state = autonomy_puppet_state }
	DDR = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage = 10 } } }
	add_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_german_confederation
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------- Imperia hooks
# THIS = GER, PREV = target. Lifts the Imperia military (COCOM) sanction on the target.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_lift_mil_sanction_on_prev = {
	PREV = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_array = { imp_mil_sanc_on_us = ROOT } }
			remove_from_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = ROOT }
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = opinion_mil_sanctioned_us }
			ROOT = { remove_from_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = PREV } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 4 }
			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_on_sanction_lifted = yes }
		}
	}
}

# THIS = GER (ROOT), PREV = target. Imposes Imperia economic and financial sanctions.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_sanction_prev_economic = {
	PREV = {
		IMP_sanctions_add_eco_from_prev = yes
		IMP_sanctions_add_fin_from_prev = yes
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 3 }
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_on_sanction_imposed = yes }
	}
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_lift_eco_sanction_on_prev = {
	PREV = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_array = { imp_eco_sanc_on_us = ROOT } }
			remove_from_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = ROOT }
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = opinion_eco_sanctioned_us }
			ROOT = { remove_from_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = PREV } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 3 }
			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_on_sanction_lifted = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_array = { imp_fin_sanc_on_us = ROOT } }
			remove_from_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = ROOT }
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = opinion_fin_sanctioned_us }
			ROOT = { remove_from_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = PREV } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 2 }
			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_on_sanction_lifted = yes }
		}
	}
}

# THIS = sponsor (GER), PREV = target. Starts Imperia Public Political Support for the party
# slot in temp cwger_t_party (a party foundation campaign, e.g. Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung).
COLDWAR_GER_1970_start_foundation_campaign = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			PREV = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		}
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_party = cwger_t_party } }
		mdcw_cw_start_pps = yes
	}
}

# THIS = donor (GER), PREV = target. Starts an Imperia assistance programme of type
# temp cwger_t_prog (1-8) and size temp cwger_t_size if capacity allows; otherwise refunds.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_start_programme = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized PREV = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } }
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_size = cwger_t_size }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free < cwger_t_size } }
			add_political_power = 25
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_programme_failed days = 5 value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_t_prog = 1 } check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_size@PREV = 0 } } mdcw_cw_start_program_1 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_t_prog = 2 } check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_size@PREV = 0 } } mdcw_cw_start_program_2 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_t_prog = 3 } check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_size@PREV = 0 } } mdcw_cw_start_program_3 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_t_prog = 4 } check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p4_size@PREV = 0 } } mdcw_cw_start_program_4 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_t_prog = 5 } check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p5_size@PREV = 0 } } mdcw_cw_start_program_5 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_t_prog = 6 } check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p6_size@PREV = 0 } } mdcw_cw_start_program_6 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_t_prog = 7 } check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p7_size@PREV = 0 } } mdcw_cw_start_program_7 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_t_prog = 8 } check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p8_size@PREV = 0 } } mdcw_cw_start_program_8 = yes }
		else = { add_political_power = 25 }
	}
}

# Reads Imperia/Cold War states each month and turns them into German consequences.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_imperia_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		# oil shocks reach the Federal Republic through the Imperia oil market
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier > 1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_oil_shock_seen } }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_oil_shock_seen
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.80 days = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier > 1 } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_oil_shock_seen NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_second_oil_shock_seen } date > 1978.1.1 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_second_oil_shock_seen
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.81 days = 1 }
		}
		# high world tension mobilises the peace movement
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension > 59 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_peace_movement = 0.4 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension < 35 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_peace_movement = -0.2 } } }
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_peace_movement min = 0 max = 100 } }
		# a war scare at the very top of the tension scale
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension > 79 }
				date > 1979.1.1
				NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_war_scare_seen }
			}
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_war_scare_seen
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.92 days = 3 }
		}
		# leaving the Western bloc without a plan: estrangement weakens Westbindung
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_westbindung = -0.5 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_westbindung = 0.05 } } }
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_westbindung min = 0 max = 100 } }
	}
	# Soviet tree compatibility: the Quadripartite Agreement is one fact for both sides
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_berlin_agreement NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_berlin_agreement } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_berlin_agreement
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_berlin_access = 15 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_berlin_access min = 0 max = 100 } }
	}
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ monthly
COLDWAR_GER_1970_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = GER IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_initialized }
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_update_bundestag = yes
		log = "[GetDateText]: COLDWAR_GER_1970 Bundestag: ruling party [?ruling_party|0], government [?cwger_seats_gov|0] of [?cwger_seats_total|0] seats, margin [?cwger_margin|0], defectors [?cwger_defectors|0]; last election CDU [?cwger_parliament_shares^1|%1] SPD [?cwger_parliament_shares^3|%1] FDP [?cwger_parliament_shares^2|%1] Greens [?cwger_parliament_shares^17|%1]; coalition partners [?gov_coalition_array^num|0]"
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_terror_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_inner_german_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_imperia_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_politics_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_dark_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_dom_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_bomb_watch = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_gw_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_events_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_mechanics_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_update_modifiers = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_politics_tick = {
	# scandals surface when pressure has built up
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_scandal = -0.25 } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_scandal min = 0 max = 100 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwger_scandal > 39 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_scandal_cooldown } }
		random_list = {
			80 = { }
			20 = {
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwger_scandal > 60 } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_scandal_cooldown days = 360 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.100 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	# Länder elections act as mid-term referendums on Bonn
	random_list = {
		85 = { }
		15 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.25 days = 1 } }
	}
	# the peace and anti-nuclear movements feed the Greens once they exist
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_greens_founded }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_peace_movement > 50 } }  }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_anti_nuclear > 50 } }  }
	}
	# a shrinking majority invites defections and a constructive vote of no confidence
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cwger_margin < 3 }
			OR = { check_variable = { cwger_defectors > 0 } date > 1971.1.1 }
			OR = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_no_confidence_cooldown }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = elections_in_progress }
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_no_confidence_cooldown days = 540 value = 1 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_majority_crisis
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.19 days = 1 }
	}
	# FDP drifts with its electorate
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } is_in_array = { gov_coalition_array = 2 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_fdp_course = 0.1 } } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_fdp_course min = -100 max = 100 } }
	# the Bundesbank watches inflation (Imperia/MD monetary variables)
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { inflation_rate_var > 0.05 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_bundesbank = 1 } } }
	else = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_bundesbank = -0.5 } } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_bundesbank min = 0 max = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_bundesbank > 70 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_bundesbank_cooldown } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_bundesbank_cooldown days = 540 value = 1 }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.85 days = 1 }
	}
	# party leadership succession in opposition
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_leadership_tick = yes
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_leadership_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwger_cdu_leader = 1 } date > 1973.6.12 NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_cdu_leader = 2 } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.30 days = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } } check_variable = { cwger_spd_leader < 3 } date > 1982.12.1 }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 3 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } } check_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 3 } date > 1986.8.25 }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 4 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } } check_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 4 } date > 1990.3.19 }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 5 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } } check_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 5 } date > 1991.5.29 date < 1995.11.1 }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 6 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } } check_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 6 } date > 1993.6.25 }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 7 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } } check_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 7 } date > 1995.11.16 }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 5 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_lafontaine_mannheim
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_lafontaine_mannheim check_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 5 } date > 1998.3.2 }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 8 } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.36 days = 1 }
	}
	# FDP chairmanship
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_fdp_leader = 1 } date > 1974.10.1 } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_fdp_leader = 2 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_fdp_leader = 2 } date > 1992.5.18 } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_fdp_leader = 3 } } }
}


# Called from set_leader (00_leader_setup_scripted_effects.txt) for GER in the 1970 scenario.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_set_leader = {

	update_set_politics = yes

		create_country_leader = { name = "The National Directorate" picture = "gfx/leaders/GER/GER_interim.dds" expire = "2050.1.1" ideology = Nat_Fascism }
	}

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 1 } } create_country_leader = { name = "Willy Brandt" picture = "gfx/Leaders/GER/GER_Coldwar_WillyBrandt.dds" expire = "2050.1.1" ideology = socialism traits = { western_socialism } } }

		create_country_leader = { name = "Franz Schönhuber" picture = "gfx/leaders/GER/1970/COLDWAR_GER_1970_schoenhuber.dds" expire = "2050.1.1" ideology = Nat_Populism }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 } }
		create_country_leader = { name = "Adolf von Thadden" picture = "gfx/leaders/GER/GER_interim.dds" expire = "2050.1.1" ideology = Nat_Fascism }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 } }
		create_country_leader = { name = "Herbert Mies" picture = "gfx/leaders/GER/GER_interim.dds" expire = "2050.1.1" ideology = communist_state }
	}
	else = {
		set_leader_GER = yes
	}
}

# Re-create the head of government after a party leadership change.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_refresh_leader = {
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = GER IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_set_leader = yes
	}
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------ event helpers

COLDWAR_GER_1970_dark_seize = {
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_dark_regime
	set_global_flag = cwger_dark_germany
	clr_global_flag = cwger_dark_germany_ended
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_resistance = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_bonn_republic } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_bonn_republic }
	add_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_dark_regime
	set_temp_variable = { rul_party_temp = 21 }
set_temp_variable = { disable_elections = 1 }
change_ruling_party_effect = yes
COLDWAR_GER_1970_update_bundestag = yes
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_refresh_leader = yes
	add_stability = -0.05
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 15 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = -30 } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
	every_other_country = {
		limit = { has_idea = NATO_member }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GDARK.20 days = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV } SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GDARK.30 days = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = DDR } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GDARK.40 days = 1 } } }
	every_other_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { has_idea = NATO_member } NOT = { original_tag = SOV } NOT = { original_tag = DDR } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GDARK.10 days = 1 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_dark_restore = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_dark_regime
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_dark_failed
	clr_global_flag = cwger_dark_germany
	set_global_flag = cwger_dark_germany_ended
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_dark_regime } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_dark_regime }
	add_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_bonn_republic
	set_temp_variable = { rul_party_temp = 1 }
set_temp_variable = { col_one = 2 }
set_temp_variable = { disable_elections = 0 }
change_ruling_party_effect = yes
COLDWAR_GER_1970_update_bundestag = yes
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_refresh_leader = yes
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_dark = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_rechtsstaat = 30 } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_rechtsstaat min = 0 max = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -10 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes }
	every_other_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_idea = NATO_member is_ai = no } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GDARK.25 days = 2 }
	}
}

# Monthly, GER scope: far-right vote shares, the slow recovery of the republic, the resistance.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_dark_tick = {
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_far_right_pop = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_far_right_pop = party_pop_array^21 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_far_right_elect = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_far_right_elect = cwger_parliament_shares^21 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_dark_regime } }
		# democratic institutions recover by themselves unless someone keeps pushing
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_dark = -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_rechtsstaat > 60 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_dark = -0.5 } } }
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_dark min = 0 max = 100 } }
	}
	else = {
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_resistance = 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_stability < 0.35 } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_resistance = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_security > 80 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_resistance = -0.5 } } }
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_resistance min = 0 max = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = cwger_resistance_cd } }
			random_list = { 92 = { } 8 = { modifier = { add = 6 check_variable = { cwger_resistance > 40 } } set_country_flag = { flag = cwger_resistance_cd days = 180 value = 1 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GDARK.60 days = 1 } } }
		}
	}
}


# Monthly, GER scope: the two-thirds line of the Bundestag as elected.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_dom_tick = {
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_two_thirds = cwger_seats_total } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwger_two_thirds = 0.6666 } }
	# vote shares of possible coalitions at the last election
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_rg_share = cwger_parliament_shares^3 } }
	if = { limit = { custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_GER_1970_tt_roster_greens always = no } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_rg_share = cwger_parliament_shares^17 } } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_cf_share = cwger_parliament_shares^1 } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_cf_share = cwger_parliament_shares^2 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_sl_share = cwger_parliament_shares^3 } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_sl_share = cwger_parliament_shares^2 } }
}


# Monthly, GER scope: the world reacts when the German bomb project is finished.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_bomb_watch = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_bomb_programme NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_german_bomb } is_special_project_completed = sp:sp_nuclear_bomb }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_german_bomb
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_westbindung = -10 } }
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_westbindung min = 0 max = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 10 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes }
		every_other_country = { limit = { OR = { original_tag = USA original_tag = SOV original_tag = FRA original_tag = ENG } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GBR.90 days = 1 } }
		every_other_country = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GDIP.310 days = 1 } }
	}
}

# Bundestag shares of the possible coalitions from the last election result (parties under 5% get no seats).
COLDWAR_GER_1970_coalition_math = {

hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_bt_total = 0 } }

hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_bt_pds = 0 } }

hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_bt_pds = 0 } }
hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_bt_fdp = 0 } }

hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_bt_greens = 0 } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^17 > 0.0499 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_bt_greens = cwger_parliament_shares^17 } } }
hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_bt_greens = 0 } }
hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_bt_rep = 0 } }

hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_bt_rep = 0 } }
hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_bt_npd = 0 } }

if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^0 > 0.0499 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_bt_total = cwger_parliament_shares^0 } } }

if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^3 > 0.0499 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_bt_total = cwger_parliament_shares^3 } } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^4 > 0.0499 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_bt_total = cwger_parliament_shares^4 } } }

if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_parliament_shares^23 > 0.0499 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_bt_total = cwger_parliament_shares^23 } } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_bt_total < 0.01 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_bt_total = 1 } } }

hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_q_rg = cwger_bt_greens } }
hidden_effect = { divide_variable = { cwger_q_rg = cwger_bt_total } }
}

# Hostage exchange: the state releases prisoners and becomes blackmailable.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_hostage_exchange = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_hostage_crisis_active
	hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { cwger_raf_prisoners = 3 } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_raf_prisoners min = 0 max = 40 } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_cadre = 6 } }
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_state_blackmailable days = 1500 value = 1 }
}


# Monthly event triggers for West Germany. None of them is dated to the day: each needs
# a window and the right conditions, and some never happen at all.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_events_tick = {
	# Brandt's successor: the spy affair, or a later hand-over
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } check_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 1 } date > 1973.9.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_guillaume_done } check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 39 } }
		random_list = {
			92 = { }
			8 = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_guillaume_done
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_counterintel > 55 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.29 days = 1 } }
				else = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.28 days = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } check_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 1 } date > 1976.12.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_brandt_handover } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_brandt_handover
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.34 days = 3 }
	}
	# the FDP looks for a new partner
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } is_in_array = { gov_coalition_array = 2 } check_variable = { cwger_fdp_course > 40 } date > 1976.6.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_fdp_switch_cooldown } NOT = { has_country_flag = elections_in_progress } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_fdp_switch_cooldown days = 720 value = 1 }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.26 days = 5 }
	}
	# Union leadership
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } } date > 1979.5.1 date < 1983.1.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_kfrage_done } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_kfrage_done
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.31 days = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } } OR = { check_variable = { cwger_cdu_leader = 3 } check_variable = { cwger_cdu_leader = 4 } } date > 1981.1.1 date < 1990.1.1 }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_cdu_leader = 2 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } check_variable = { cwger_cdu_leader = 2 } date > 1989.6.1 date < 1989.10.1 check_variable = { party_pop_array^1 < 0.37 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_bremen_done } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_bremen_done
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.37 days = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } } check_variable = { cwger_cdu_leader = 2 } date > 1998.11.1 }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_cdu_leader = 6 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } } check_variable = { cwger_spd_leader = 5 } date > 1990.3.1 date < 1990.6.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_cologne_attack_done } }
		random_list = { 70 = { } 30 = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_cologne_attack_done country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.38 days = 1 } } }
	}
	# Munich 1972
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1972.8.26 date < 1972.9.11 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_munich_happened } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_munich_rolled } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_munich_rolled
		random_list = {
			60 = { modifier = { factor = 0.4 has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_olympic_security } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.66 days = 1 } }
			40 = { modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_olympic_security } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.67 days = 1 } }
			10 = { modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_olympic_security } }
		}
	}
	# the German Autumn ends one way or another
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwger_raf_gen = 2 } date > 1982.1.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_deutscher_herbst_over } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_deutscher_herbst_over
	}
	# economy and society
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1982.1.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_strike_done } check_variable = { labour_unions_opinion < 60 } }
		random_list = { 97 = { } 3 = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_strike_done country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.82 days = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1980.1.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_steel_done } }
		random_list = { 98 = { } 2 = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_steel_done country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.84 days = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwger_peace_movement > 50 } date > 1979.6.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_peace_demo_cooldown } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_peace_demo_cooldown days = 900 value = 1 }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.90 days = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwger_anti_nuclear > 25 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_brokdorf_cooldown } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_brokdorf_cooldown days = 1200 value = 1 }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.91 days = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_GER_1970_tt_roster_greens always = no } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_greens_founded } date > 1979.1.1 OR = { date > 1980.1.1 check_variable = { cwger_anti_nuclear > 30 } check_variable = { cwger_peace_movement > 40 } } }
		random_list = { 70 = { } 30 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.93 days = 2 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_GER_1970_tt_roster_rep always = no } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_rep_founded } date > 1983.10.1 OR = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_GER_1970_billion_credit has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_GER_1970_strauss_east_credit } }
		random_list = { 90 = { } 10 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.94 days = 2 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_asylum_seen } OR = { date > 1991.6.1 AND = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_wall_open date > 1990.6.1 } AND = { date > 1985.1.1 check_variable = { imp_refugee_pressure > 0.15 } } } }
		random_list = { 85 = { } 15 = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_asylum_seen country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.95 days = 2 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1986.4.20 date < 1986.7.1 country_exists = SOV NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_chernobyl_rolled } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_chernobyl_rolled
		random_list = { 65 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.96 days = 3 } } 35 = { } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1981.1.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_waldsterben_done } }
		random_list = { 96 = { } 4 = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_waldsterben_done country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.97 days = 2 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = DDR check_variable = { cwger_berlin_access < 40 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_transit_cooldown } has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension > 50 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_transit_cooldown days = 720 value = 1 }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.120 days = 2 }
	}
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_ddr_events_tick = yes
}


# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: Validate both states before withdrawing any resident.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_transfer_uebersiedler_600 = {
 set_temp_variable = { cwger_ue_arrived = 0 }
 if = { limit = {
  DDR = { exists = yes any_owned_state = { is_controlled_by = DDR state_population > 600 } }
  any_owned_state = { is_controlled_by = GER }
 }
  DDR = {
   hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_ue_reserve_before = manpower } }
   random_owned_state = { limit = { is_controlled_by = DDR state_population > 600 } save_event_target_as = cwger_ue_origin }
  }
  random_owned_state = { limit = { is_controlled_by = GER } save_event_target_as = cwger_ue_destination }
  event_target:cwger_ue_origin = { add_manpower = -600 }
  DDR = {
   set_temp_variable = { cwger_ue_reserve_gain = manpower }
   subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwger_ue_reserve_gain = cwger_ue_reserve_before }
   if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_ue_reserve_gain > 0 } }
    multiply_temp_variable = { cwger_ue_reserve_gain = -1 }
    add_manpower = cwger_ue_reserve_gain
   }
  }
  event_target:cwger_ue_destination = { add_manpower = 600 }
  hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_uebersiedler_k = 0.6 } }
  set_temp_variable = { cwger_ue_arrived = 600 }
  DDR = { ingame_update_setup = yes }
  ingame_update_setup = yes
 }
}

# DDR scope. The Chinese solution: works only while Moscow stands behind the SED and the
# security organs still obey. Otherwise the troops refuse and the border opens.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_ddr_crackdown_roll = {
	random_list = {
		30 = {
			modifier = { add = 25 check_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing > 60 } }
			modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwddr_sed_control > 55 } }
			modifier = { add = -20 check_variable = { cwddr_opposition > 60 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0.3 has_idea = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_ddr_crackdown }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage = 9 } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_sed_control = 15 } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_crisis = -25 } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_opposition = -20 } }
			hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_sed_control min = 0 max = 100 } }
			hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_crisis min = 0 max = 100 } }
			hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_opposition min = 0 max = 100 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_ddr_crackdown } } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_ddr_crackdown days = 1825 } }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER_DDR.34 days = 1 }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = GER } GER = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.131 days = 2 } } }
		}
		40 = {
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER_DDR.39 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# GER scope: request unity under the chosen path (cwger_unity_path 1 = Art. 23, 2 = Art. 146).
COLDWAR_GER_1970_request_two_plus_four = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { is_ai = no } }
		SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.140 days = 3 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SOV }
		SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.140 days = 10 } }
	}
	else = {
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.141 days = 5 }
	}
}

# GER scope: carry out unity on the chosen path.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_complete_unity = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_unity_path = 2 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_art146 = yes }
	else = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_art23 = yes }
	every_other_country = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.150 days = 1 } }
}

# Monthly, GER scope: East German events that follow the GDR's own meters.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_ddr_events_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = DDR DDR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_ddr_initialized } NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_achieved } }
		if = {
			limit = { date > 1971.4.15 NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_honecker_era } }
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_honecker_era
			DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER_DDR.1 days = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { date > 1976.9.1 NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_biermann_done } DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_opposition > 9 } } }
			random_list = { 94 = { } 6 = { set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_biermann_done DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER_DDR.6 days = 1 } } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { date > 1978.1.1 NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_min_exchange_done } DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_hard_currency > 45 } } }
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_min_exchange_done
			DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER_DDR.5 days = 2 } }
		}
		# a hard-line coup in Moscow can put the Wende into reverse
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_wall_open
				country_exists = SOV
				date > 1990.1.1
				NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_moscow_coup_rolled }
				NOT = { SOV = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SOV_gor_the_sinatra_doctrine } }
			}
			random_list = {
				97 = { }
				3 = {
					set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_moscow_coup_rolled
					set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_moscow_coup_succeeded
					DDR = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing = 40 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_sed_control = 15 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_moscow_backing min = 0 max = 100 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_sed_control min = 0 max = 100 } } }
					custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_GER_1970_tt_tension_up_8
hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 8 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes } }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.145 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}


# Monthly, GER scope: the mechanics the player interacts with through missions and decisions.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_mechanics_tick = {
	# --- Übersiedler: people leaving the GDR legally or through the cracks
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = DDR NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_achieved } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_wall_open NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_confederation } }
			COLDWAR_GER_1970_transfer_uebersiedler_30000 = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_ue_arrived > 0 } } set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total } multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.0004 } modify_treasury_effect = yes }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_exit_pressure > 69 } } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_transfer_uebersiedler_6000 = yes }
else_if = { limit = { DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_exit_pressure > 49 } } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_transfer_uebersiedler_3000 = yes }
else_if = { limit = { DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_exit_pressure > 29 } } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_transfer_uebersiedler_1500 = yes }
else = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_transfer_uebersiedler_600 = yes }
		}
	}
	# --- the spy war: contacts with the East open doors, counter-intelligence decays without money
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration = 0.1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_ostpolitik > 50 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration = 0.15 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_achieved } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration = -1.5 } } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_counterintel = -0.15 } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_stasi_penetration min = 0 max = 100 } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_counterintel min = 0 max = 100 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 30 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_spy_cooldown } NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_achieved } }
		random_list = {
			92 = { }
			8 = {
				modifier = { add = 4 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 50 } }
				modifier = { add = 4 check_variable = { cwger_counterintel > 50 } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_spy_cooldown days = 270 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.70 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- MD protest system: mass movements put people on the streets
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_peace_movement > 50 } } custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_GER_1970_tt_protest_up_0.5 hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = protest_strength } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { protest_strength = 0 } } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { protest_strength = 0.5 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = protest_strength min = 0 max = 100 } } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_anti_nuclear > 40 } } custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_GER_1970_tt_protest_up_0.3 hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = protest_strength } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { protest_strength = 0 } } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { protest_strength = 0.3 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = protest_strength min = 0 max = 100 } } } }
	# --- MD corruption: entrenched corruption keeps the scandal machine running
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_idea = corruption_level_04 has_idea = corruption_level_05 has_idea = corruption_level_06 has_idea = corruption_level_07 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_scandal = 0.4 } } }
	# --- the euro: founded by a focus, introduced through the MD EU system once it exists
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_GER_1970_euro_founder date > 1998.12.31 NOT = { has_country_flag = EU_joined_the_eurozone } }
		joining_the_euro = yes
	}
	# --- the security state overreaches
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwger_security > 64 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_abuse_cooldown } }
		random_list = {
			94 = { }
			6 = {
				modifier = { add = 6 check_variable = { cwger_security > 80 } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_abuse_cooldown days = 540 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.75 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- the cost of the East: transfers paid every month, shrinking as the new Länder catch up
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwger_east_burden > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwger_east_burden }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.00002 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_east_burden = -0.25 } }
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_east_burden min = 0 max = 100 } }
	}
	# --- drifting away from the West
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwger_westbindung < 30 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_westbindung_crisis_seen } NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_neutral } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_westbindung_crisis_seen
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.79 days = 2 }
	}
	# --- the Soviet gas deal meets an American embargo
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_idea = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_soviet_gas has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_soviet_gas has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pipelines_to_europe_signed } date > 1981.12.1 date < 1984.1.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_pipeline_embargo_seen } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_pipeline_embargo_seen
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.86 days = 5 }
	}
	# --- Bielefeld: a pacifist party goes to war
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1999.3.24 has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_GER_1970_kosovo_decision custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_GER_1970_tt_roster_greens always = no } is_in_array = { gov_coalition_array = 17 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_bielefeld_seen } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_bielefeld_seen
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.98 days = 10 }
	}
}

# GER scope: count a vote won back (or bought) and recalculate the majority.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_win_vote = {
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_defectors = -1 } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_defectors min = -6 max = 20 } }
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_update_bundestag = yes
}
